## Consensus Translation

[Isaiah 51 — Everlasting Salvation for Zion — key verses from the EMET literal translation]

## SOPHIA's Council Notes

Isaiah 51 — "Everlasting Salvation for Zion" — part of Second Isaiah (chs.40-55). The Babylonian exile and imminent return shape the theological vision of hope and restoration.
